new_schema_justification.why_existing_schema_is_insufficient: The existing Cognitive IR has no SKILL type and using METHOD would conflate the measured concepts. Method-Use Trace R0 intentionally requires full selection/use/outcome/revision lineage, while the output schema describes responses rather than input procedures. The prior skill-only artifact records non-applicability and contains no reusable procedure representation.
new_schema_justification.retirement_condition: After Task207's future successor trials and independent evaluation are frozen and the handoff is complete, retain this schema only as Task207 historical experimental material. Do not promote it to a shared registry or reuse it in another task without a fresh representation audit.
